name: cofeb-baseline-thickness-evaluation
title: CoFeB baseline thickness evaluation of dynamic properties
description: Measurements of static and dynamic magnetic properties for a thickness series of CoFeB thin film samples. Data was collected using ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) spectroscopy to evaluate properties relevant to spin-transfer-torque magnetoresistive random access memory (MRAM) devices.
